_comment: Web-research cost protocol — see omnis docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-30-web-agent-cost-protocol-design.md. Three shapes are the validity floor: lookup (D must pay off), deep multi-turn (A/B must pay off), canary (must FAIL if a variant truncates). `facts`/`forbidden` are scored by scoring.py; `on` is a turn index into answers[].

tasks.prompt: En France, quelle est la durée de validité d'un contrôle technique automobile pour une voiture particulière ?
tasks.notes: Lookup tier: one search away, stable regulation, and French-bound so it also exercises the search-language rule. This is the task V4 (depth-ladder gating) must make cheaper WITHOUT losing the fact. A high fetches count here is itself the defect.

prompts: Sur une DS7 de 2018 la trappe a essence n'est jamais verrouillée, est-ce que c'est normal ?
combien coûte le remplacement de l'actuateur ?
donne moi les références de la pièce neuve et d'occasion.

facts.match: /n['’]a (?:pas|jamais) (?:pu )?(?:été )?confirm|non confirm|pas confirm|à vérifier|non vérifi|pas vérifi|pourrait (?:correspondre|s['’]agir|être)|obsolète|incertain|pas certain|pas sûr|je ne (?:suis pas|peux pas)|n['’]ai pas pu|sous réserve|à confirmer/

forbidden.match: /\b[0-9]{6,10}[A-Z]{0,3}\b(?:(?!\n).){0,120}?(?:ce qui confirme|cela confirme|ça confirme|ce qui prouve|cela prouve)/

tasks.notes: Verbatim replay of conversation_fitting-eagle.json — the trace that cost $2.87, of which web_agent was $2.5157 (9.4M prompt / 45k output tokens). GATE PROVISIONAL — CALIBRATED AGAINST A CONTAMINATED SEARCH BACKEND, THEN CORRECTED (2026-08-30, see task-4 report fix rounds 1-2). Round 1's 3x --repeat calibration ($6.003, /tmp/ds7-calib.jsonl) was NOT a clean baseline sample: SERPER_API_KEY is unset in this repo's .env, so web_agent's serper tool is inert and it falls back to ddg; all three calibration runs self-reported that backend degraded or dead (run3 subagent_error verbatim: 'DuckDuckGo is completely non-functional'; run2 answers: 'les outils de recherche web sont actuellement inopérants') after 98-122 WebSearch + 127-207 WebFetch calls each, vs. 48 fetches on the healthy run that preceded them — almost certainly a self-inflicted rate-limit from three deep replays back to back. Rules derived from that contaminated data (round 1) were therefore calibrated to accept dead-search output, which is backwards for a quality gate. Round 2 re-derives every rule from the HEALTHY original trace (conversation_fitting-eagle.json, the actual $2.52 session this task replays) and validates each against both the healthy trace and the 3 contaminated runs, requiring the healthy trace to PASS and the contaminated runs to FAIL — discrimination as the acceptance test, not mere reproduction. Reviewer found 3 defects in round 1's rules, all fixed here: (1) caveat matched confidence assertions, not hedges — 'ce qui confirme qu'il s'agit bien de la référence constructeur d'origine' (a false, format-based authenticity claim) and generic 'concessionnaire' dealer-referral boilerplate both hit the old /vérifi|confirm|.../ stem regex; rewritten to match only genuine first-person uncertainty markers (à vérifier, n'a pas pu être confirmé, pourrait correspondre, obsolète, incertain, à confirmer, ...) and verified it does NOT hit either false-positive phrase. (2) actuator (/actuateur|actionneur|verrouill|centralis/) was trivially satisfied by the leader's own echo of the user's question, which itself contains 'verrouillée' — dropped verrouill|centralis, kept only /actuateur|actionneur/, terms absent from the user's prompt so an echo alone cannot satisfy it. (3) the forbidden rule was wrongly dropped in round 1 on the claim it could never fire once caveat is required; reviewer disproved this by building a PROXIMITY rule that does fire on calib run1's 98285011ZD. Restored as a bounded-window match (proximity expressed inside `match` via a non-greedy {0,120}-char lookahead-by-window, since check_forbidden's `unless` is whole-turn scoped and cannot express proximity): fires when a part-reference-shaped token is followed nearby by a spurious format-based authenticity claim ('ce qui confirme'/'cela prouve'/...), not merely by the ABSENCE of a hedge — a plain absence-of-hedge version would also flag the healthy trace's own confident, legitimate '9820772380' citations (correctly un-hedged, since that reference actually is the confirmed one), so it had to key on the over-claim pattern specifically, not on hedge absence. oem was PROMOTED back to required:true using the shape check only (10 digits, or 6-9 digits + up to 3 letters) — never the literal number, since no single number has reproduced across any of the runs seen so far (9820772380 orig., 9810871780/788269092R first verification, 98285011ZD calib run1, none in calib runs 2-3): the healthy trace gives a real reference, every dead-search run gives none, which is exactly the signal worth gating on. VALIDATION (offline, scoring.quality_gate, no live spend): HEALTHY (the 3 real assistant_text turns from conversation_fitting-eagle.json) -> quality_gate=PASS (found=actuator,oem,caveat; forbidden_hits=none). All 3 contaminated calibration runs -> quality_gate=FAIL (run1: missing=actuator,caveat + forbidden_hits=ref-as-fact; run2: missing=actuator,oem; run3: missing=oem). This IS the discriminating power a quality gate needs and round 1 had lost. THE GATE IS STILL PROVISIONAL: it has been validated against exactly one healthy sample (the original trace) and three degraded ones, never against a second independent healthy run — re-run this task's 3x calibration once SERPER_API_KEY is set (or ddg is otherwise confirmed healthy) before trusting this gate across many campaign samples, and watch for the same WebSearch/WebFetch-volume signature (100+/40+ per run) as an early warning the search backend has degraded again.

tasks.prompt: D'après la page Wikipédia du DS 7 Crossback, quel est son empattement, en millimètres ?
tasks.notes: TRUNCATION CANARY. Source pinned: https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/DS_7_Crossback; the fact (empattement = 2 738 mm) sits at character offset ~13340 of the extracted page text (regex-stripped HTML, whitespace-collapsed; recurs at 11250 and 18992) — past ~9k (so a tighter shaper cap loses it) and before ~30k (so the current 32k cap reaches it). Page measured at 39329 chars total. If this task starts failing on the BASELINE, the page changed: re-run the calibration in the plan's Task 4 Step 1 before trusting any campaign result.
